Our story

From one book to a reading community.

The Wildkhard Reading Club began in February 2022 with a simple rule: read African books, and talk about them honestly. Our first pick was Damilare Kuku's Nearly All the Men in Lagos Are Mad.

Every month begins with a new African book. Members read at their own pace, share thoughts by text through the weeks, and join a review call on the last Sunday. We have read novels, short stories, poetry, plays, essays and testimony: classics like Nervous Conditions, A Grain of Wheat, So Long a Letter and Woman at Point Zero; modern favourites like Homegoing, Kintu, Open Water and An Orchestra of Minorities; fresh releases like Dream Count, The Shadow King, Afterlives and How Beautiful We Were; and books by our own members.

Our members come from different tribes, backgrounds and orientations. The one thing we ask of everyone is respect for each other's opinions and views. The club is a place to disagree well and to support each other.
